You can follow the recipe and still never bake the cake.

Kevin Trudeau uses a chocolate cake to make his point. If the recipe says flour, water and salt, you are missing the eggs, the vanilla and even the chocolate. Some of the ingredients you are given are simply wrong.

He says the books on manifesting often work the same way. They give you part of the recipe, so you never get the result they describe.

Have you ever followed good advice and still felt something was missing?

#ad #success #goals #kevintrudeau

You can want something with all your heart and still not be heard.

Kevin Trudeau compares the universe to a radio. You may be broadcasting your desire for more money with great intensity, all day long. But if you are on 97.9 FM and the receiver is tuned to AM 1040, nothing comes through.

His point is that wanting something is not enough. The frequency you send it on matters too.

Where in your life do you feel you are sending a strong signal and getting no answer?

#ad #money #mindset #success

The advice online sounds good. Kevin Trudeau says the rich don't follow it.

He was with a group of very wealthy men and asked each one if they had ever meditated or visualized their wealth while they were building it. They looked at him like he was insane.

Kevin's point is that a lot of advice is theory. He wants to share what people who actually get results really do.

Have you ever followed advice that sounded smart and went nowhere?

#ad #money #wealth #mindset

Kevin Trudeau's kung fu teacher spotted one habit to correct in him.

Grandmaster Tai, a close friend, taught him to breathe in and out through the nose and to keep his attention just below the belly button. Tai told him this would make him stronger in every way, mentally as well as physically.

Kevin says it also builds your ability to manifest, and that it is a habit anyone can practise through the day.

What small habit has made you stronger over time?
